text: Algesia [Gr. algein , to have pain]: Ger. Schmerzempfindlichkeit ; Fr. algésie ; Ital. algesia . The capacity for having pain. As ANALGESIA (q.v.) expresses the absence of the sense of pain, algesia expresses its normal presence; it is also used (Tuke) as a synonym of HYPERAESTHESIA (q.v.). See PLEASURE AND PAIN (also for Literature ). ( J.J. )
